derivations.claim: On a sufficiently small neighborhood the positive spatial metric makes each Gram–Schmidt denominator strictly positive. Hence the adapted orthonormal frame and its inverse coframe are smooth functions of $g$; differentiating the frame introduces only $g$ and $\partial g$. In that frame the six components of $dF$ and $d\star_gF$ with one normal slot are exactly the six evolution equations, while their all-spatial components are the two divergence constraints.

Freeze the tetrad at a point and use its timelike vector as the time direction. The $(0,i,j)$ components of $dF=0$, with $F_{0i}=-e_i$ and $F_{ij}=\epsilon_{ijk}b_k$, give $n(b)+\operatorname{curl}e=0$. The spatial components of $\nabla_aF^{ai}=0$, equivalent to $d\star_gF=0$, give $n(e)-\operatorname{curl}b=0$. Hence the spatial symbol in the convention $n(U)+A^j\mathsf e_j(U)=0$ is $S(\xi)$. Since $C(\xi)^T=-C(\xi)$, its two off-diagonal blocks are transposes and $S(\xi)^T=S(\xi)$. Also $|C(\xi)v|^2=|\xi|^2|v|^2-(\xi\cdot v)^2$, so $\|C(\xi)\|=|\xi|$ and $\|S(\xi)\|=|\xi|$.

The identity $C(\xi)^2v=\xi(\xi\cdot v)-|\xi|^2v$ shows that $-C(\xi)^2$ has eigenvalues $0,|\xi|^2,|\xi|^2$. Squaring $S(\xi)$ therefore gives eigenvalues $0,0,|\xi|^2,|\xi|^2,|\xi|^2,|\xi|^2$; because $S$ is symmetric and has trace zero, its eigenvalues are $0,0,|\xi|,|\xi|,-|\xi|,-|\xi|$. For any $z\in\mathbb R^6$, $z^TP(\zeta)z\ge(\zeta(n)-|\zeta_\perp|_h)|z|^2$, proving positivity on the stated future covector cone. Taking $\zeta=ds$ gives $ds(n)=\alpha^{-1}$ and $\zeta_\perp=0$, hence the positive time matrix $\alpha^{-1}I_6$. The shift contributes only scalar multiples of $I_6$ to spatial matrices, so those matrices remain symmetric.

The frame-derivative, Hodge-coefficient, and commutator terms contain at most first derivatives of $g$ and no derivatives of $(e,b)$; they are smooth on the open state set where $g$ is Lorentzian, $\alpha>0$, and $h>0$. This proves the claimed lower-order form and completes the conditional reduction proof.
